name: SplatQ
aliases: SplatQ: Post-training Gaussian pruning via QUBO
definition: SplatQ is a post-training Gaussian pruning framework that partitions Gaussians by spatial proximity and appearance similarity into size-limited blocks, smooths importance-based block retention quotas to prevent budget concentration, and constructs a quadratic approximation of joint deletion effects to jointly select Gaussians under a fixed budget.
summary: SplatQ is a post-training pruning framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting that uses QUBO optimization to jointly select Gaussians, addressing spatial quality imbalance and ignored joint deletion effects.
